spans.name: StateGraph: autonomous-coding-agent execution
spans.detail: Complete graph execution: 12 nodes dispatched, 3,420 total tokens consumed.

spans.detail: Indexed 14 symbols, identified 2 relevant files, captured baseline SHA-256 snapshot.

spans.name: Span 2: manager_planner (Formulate ManagerPlan)
spans.detail: Decomposed task into 4 acceptance criteria and target file list.

spans.detail: Synthesized initial implementation in payments/calc.py via atomic shadow diff.

spans.detail: Centralized retry budget incremented (iter=1); routed to delegate_debug.

spans.name: Span 7: debugger (AST Stackframe Diagnosis)
spans.detail: Bottom-up traceback analysis isolated missing zero-guard at line 42; formulated fix plan.

spans.name: Span 8: coder (Apply Fix Plan iter=1)
spans.detail: Applied surgical patch adding zero-divisor guard without touching other methods.

spans.name: Span 9: sandbox_runner (Re-test Verification)
spans.detail: PASSED: All 4 tests green, 0 regressions, exit code 0.

spans.name: Span 10: manager_evaluate (Route to Reviewer)
spans.detail: Test results confirmed green; routed to delegate_review.

spans.name: Span 11: reviewer (Adversarial Audit & SHA256)
spans.detail: Approved 9.2/10, 0 security blocking issues, captured cryptographic SHA-256 hashes.

spans.name: Span 12: manager_finalize (Sovereign 4-Pillars)
spans.detail: 4 pillars verified, TOCTOU check passed, sealed delivery tarball generated.
